requirements.text: Scenario 1 — Example Operations page renders non-blank; OperationComboBox present and switches processing; Preview/Output images present; CurrentOperationTextBlock and FPSMonitor present.
requirements.reason: Migrated WinUI 3 window launches but renders blank; the entire Scenario 1 page (OperationComboBox, CurrentOperationTextBlock, PreviewImage, OutputImage, FPSMonitor) is absent from both the render and the UIA tree. Only the un-painted nav shell exists.
requirements.suspected_skill_gap: MainPage.OnNavigatedTo replaced Window.Current.Bounds.Width with Page.ActualWidth (== 0 before first layout), so the adaptive branch skipped ScenarioControl.SelectedIndex = 0 and ScenarioFrame.Navigate was never called. The windowing migration anchor covers Window.Current generally but does not warn that window-size reads (Bounds) cannot be replaced with Page.ActualWidth.

visual_discrepancies.uwp: Full UI: 'Current: Blur', OperationComboBox, Preview/Output image grid.
visual_discrepancies.winui: Empty content frame; only the (unpainted) nav shell exists in the UIA tree.

summary: App builds and stays alive but opens to an empty scenario frame because the initial scenario was never selected/navigated. Root cause: Window.Current.Bounds.Width was replaced with Page.ActualWidth (0 pre-layout) in OnNavigatedTo, defeating the adaptive auto-select-scenario-0 logic shared by the Windows-universal-samples shell.
